README.description: Current SAHZU analyses use the full 60-record development pool and 220 of 244 test records in each of 100 repeats. Sensitivity to 90% development sampling and the original 301-record internal evaluation are separate. H_ sheets retain original fixed-cohort analyses.

Mean and sample SD over repeats, not confidence limits. Ratios are calculated within each repeat; undefined values remain missing, with valid n. All aggregate repeat records are retained in repeat100/summary in the code archive.

Definitions.definition: Correct low/normal/high reports divided by all reports.
Number reported divided by all sampled test records.

Retained original fixed-cohort or exploratory analysis; original denominators and protocol apply.

This post hoc display selection does not change whole-cohort evaluation.
